title: REMOVEFILTERS () with no arguments removes every filter of the filter context
query: EVALUATE CALCULATETABLE ( ROW ( "r", CALCULATE ( [Sales Amount], REMOVEFILTERS () ) ), 'Customer'[Country] = "JP", 'Date'[Year] = 2024 )

source.supports: the page's Example 1 uses REMOVEFILTERS () for the grand total in the denominator

source.quote: it can be used only as a CALCULATE modifier and not as a table expression like ALL
source.supports: REMOVEFILTERS is an alias for ALL as a CALCULATE modifier

derivation: Outer filters Country = JP and Year = 2024 give rows 5, 6 = 230. REMOVEFILTERS () removes both: 540.
notes: SUM of a fixed decimal (currency) column is taken to be a fixed decimal, as in the seed cases.
